payload.text: UNTIL THE KOVACS RUN, THE PRE-COMMIT GATE'S STALE-AT ADVISORY NAMES ST0081's AT-05.1 ON EVERY COMMIT ("the file EXISTS while the row says to-write"). It is expected and advisory: vc ran stale_at_check.sh on 2026-10-12, which flags AT-05.1 and exits 0. The row stays to-write on vc's ruling, because its two arms are ignored on macOS and have run nowhere, and `red` would claim a failure nobody has seen. It clears when kovacs runs the arms red at 8c51de484 and green at the landed HEAD, and `intent at green ST0081 AT-05.1` records both.
